title: panicum vescum
intro: Panicum vescum, commonly known as switchgrass, is a type of perennial grass native to North America. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Panicum vescum include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, diarrhea, and coughs, through its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Panicum vescum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
